label: Diagram 19
caption: Diagram 19 Heights and arrangement of fittings in a unisex wheelchair-accessible toilet (looking towards wall A in diagram 18)
description: This is an elevation, titled Diagram 19, looking towards wall A of a unisex wheelchair-accessible toilet. The wall carries, left to right, a dashed rectangle labelled HD, then SD and PT set above a small U-shaped basin, then TP and AR. Two angled rails marked "Grab rails" sit above these groups. A top note describes an "Alarm pull cord with two red bangles, one at 100mm, the other at 800mm to 1000mm above floor level," with the cord line drawn at the right. A right-hand shelf is marked "Location of shelf at 950mm above floor level." On the left, a leader points to the "Sanitary dispenser with coin slot between 750mm and 1000mm above the floor"; below it are dashed rectangles labelled "Shelf" and "Disposal bin" with a further dashed rectangle marked 72–740mm between them, and a vertical dimension of 800–1000mm is shown on the outer left. The right edge shows 300mm, 300mm, 1100mm and 680mm, with a horizontal grab rail and an angled drop-down rail whose lower end is at 100mm above the floor; a dimension of 480mm is shown below the central U-shaped fitting. A legend defines HD, SD, PT, AR and TP, with a note that the height is subject to manufacturing tolerance of the WC pan, and a bottom caption stating that the height of drop-down rails is to be the same as the other horizontal grab rails.
